market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely range-bound with upside bias into Trump-Xi summit. Oil below $100 supports equities but diesel/shipping inflation offsets. Semiconductor rally may extend but face profit-taking. Fed policy tension with White House creates volatility. Turkey/Gabon EM stress is contained but watch for contagion. Bitcoin above $86K supports risk appetite.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish for semiconductors through 2030 ($753B TAM). Critical metals and rare earths become strategic allocation. US-China decoupling in chips creates dual-supply-chain premium. Inflation likely sticky at 3-3.5% through 2027. Crypto/stablecoin integration by Apple/Google reshapes payments landscape. Media consolidation completes but faces political headwinds.
